Definition: a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies
BiblicalUsage: benayim — a champion, a man between two armies — it shows up twice, in 1 Samuel 17:4 and 1 Samuel 17:23.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that benayim shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
